title: Anthropic to Watermark AI-Generated Text from Its Models to Comply with EU Regulations
summary: Anthropic has announced it will implement watermarking for text generated by its AI models, including Claude, to comply with the EU AI Act's Transparency Code. The watermarking will apply to all new models released after August 2, 2026, and will persist even when text is copied or edited. The company is using the C2PA open standard for files and will extend support to older models. The move aligns with broader industry efforts to mark AI-generated content amid regulatory and user scrutiny.
key_points: Anthropic will watermark AI-generated text from its models, including Claude, to comply with the EU AI Act’s Transparency Code.
The watermarking applies to all models released after August 2, 2026, and will persist through copying, pasting, and some editing.
For files, Anthropic is using the C2PA open standard for watermarking.
The company plans to extend watermarking support to older models as well.
Watermarking will be applied across Anthropic’s products, including Claude platform API, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Tag.
Other companies like Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI have also committed to adhering to the EU’s transparency requirements.
The industry is adopting watermarking to address regulatory scrutiny and user backlash over AI-generated content.
